name: smwgraphics-smooth-super-mario-world-question-block
title: Smooth Super Mario World Question Block
description:
Who doesn't like the standard Super Mario World question block?
This is an update to the classic question block that we love!
Now the block has 15 frames in the animation.
Each frame, the ? icon goes 1 pixel to the right.
